messages.subject: Project Onyx — agreed heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Following our call, I attach the heads of terms agreed in principle between our respective clients: price £18.65m, 10% deposit on exchange, sold subject to the four occupational leases, TOGC treatment, exchange targeted 13 March and completion 2 April. Exclusivity to 13 March.

We'll circulate the draft contract and data room link shortly.

Martin Greaves
Partner, Marlowe Greaves LLP
